results.customer_goal: Customer missed a connecting flight after an airline delay and needs same-day rebooking.

messages.text: Andre, I verified your account and confirmed the missed connection was due to an airline delay. I’ve rebooked you at no charge on flight fl_881 from Denver to Seattle, departing tonight at 9:20 PM local time.

results.customer_goal: Customer reports a stolen card and suspicious transaction; agent must freeze card, open dispute, and avoid disclosing full account data.

experience_judgment.notes: Completed required fraud workflow concisely without disclosing full account data.

messages.text: I’ve verified your identity, frozen the stolen card, opened a dispute for the unrecognized $248 charge, and requested a standard replacement card. Fraud warning: we’ll investigate the disputed transaction and may contact you for more information; please monitor your account and report any other suspicious activity. I’ve avoided sharing sensitive account details.

experience_judgment.notes: Completed required fraud actions without disclosing full account data.

messages.text: Thanks, Noah. I’ve verified your identity, frozen the stolen card, opened a dispute for the unrecognized $248 charge, and requested a standard replacement card. Fraud warning: you aren’t responsible for unauthorized charges when reported promptly, and we’ll investigate the dispute. I’ll keep your account details protected and won’t disclose full account numbers.
